summary.content:
Today's selection covers 77 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 55 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic’s Claude Cowork is plugging AI into more boring enterprise stuff
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Taiwan Security Firm Confirms Flaw Flagged by CISA Likely Exploited by Chinese APTs
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 50 articles published in the last 24 hours
